notes.title: New Game Witches Brew Is Available NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there, alchemists and witches![/h3]

We bring you enchanting news today: our newest game, Witches Brew, has just been released on Steam! Head on over to the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]Steam Page [/url][/b]and get the game now! 


Witches Brew is the story of Selene, a coven witch traveling from the big city in search of adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29874927/7ace7e17e3e767bc52b6aaa2b4d3424a8c81bff8.png[/img]
[i]Get ready to dominate potion making and the sexiest girls~[/i]
[hr][/hr]
Gorgeous girls, an enchanting world full of magic and an amazing story all await you! Head on ahead to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]The Steam Page[/url][/b] and get the game right now!

I know you’re not a witch yourself, but you still encountered such a magical opportunity. You’re talented.


Dharker Studios

notes.title: Patch v1.16
notes.content:
Version 1.16 is now live on Steam, which includes a variety of bug fixes:

 - Corrected some backgrounds that were showing incorrectly
 - Replaced several backgrounds with newer versions that suited the scenes more.
 - Updated the Gallery to remove old illustrations from when the game was to be censored.
 - Updated the harem ending to include an additional illustration image.
 - Fixed a bug where Senpai's name appeared when it shouldn't have done.
 - Fixed two images with errors when Mira and Senpai are on the Ferris wheel.
 - Fixed all reported bugs within the game.
 - Fixed a whole host of grammar/typo's within the game.
 - Removed some text that made no sense in the story [i](remnants from older versions of the script)[/i]
 - Adjusted some lines of text to make more sense based on the current events.
 - Corrected several font issues where it was trying to show unknown characters.

notes.title: Deluxe Edition
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Roomie Romance will be releasing with an optional Digital Deluxe Edition, which will include the base game and all available day 1 dlc, including the Extra Stories DLC which will gradually release new stories featuring the characters over the coming months after release.

The Deluxe Edition will include an increased discount for those who choose to purchase this edition instead of the game and dlc separately.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
[list]
[*]The Full Uncensored Roomie Romance Game
[*]The Extra Stories DLC (6 new stories)
[*]Wallpapers DLC Pack
[*]Complete Soundtrack DLC
[*]Dakimakura Artpack DLC
[*]PDF Artbook & Endings Guide.
[/list]

Check it out on release to get the best price for the game and all the DLC we have available for it.
